title: CmdPal JS/TS Extensions - Phase 5: gallery npm install/uninstall

proposed_comments.title: Validate the complete dependency source
proposed_comments.body:
### Validate the complete dependency source

**Severity:** `critical`

The package tarball is integrity-checked, but each dependency URL in its shrinkwrap is also an executable network trust boundary because npm honors the lockfile resolution. Accepting only the hostname permits a non-default HTTPS port, credentials, a query, or a fragment; treating `link: true` as trusted also permits a local workspace dependency without registry provenance.

Require an approved HTTPS host on the default port with no userinfo, query, or fragment, and reject workspace-link entries rather than bypassing resolution and SRI validation. Cover these rejected forms in the artifact and lockfile tests.

confidence.rationale: The corrected candidate rejects non-canonical lockfile URLs and workspace links before npm can fetch dependencies.

proposed_comments.title: Revalidate reparse-safe filesystem paths
proposed_comments.body:
### Revalidate reparse-safe filesystem paths

**Severity:** `critical`

The staging directory and extension root can be redirected through a junction or symbolic-link ancestor even when the final child itself is ordinary. That makes npm writes, promotion, marker cleanup, and recursive deletion operate outside the Command Palette extension tree.

Before creating, promoting, deleting, or recovering a path, walk all existing ancestors and reject reparse points. Repeat the check immediately before recursive deletion and after root creation, and fail closed when the path cannot be inspected.

confidence.rationale: Recursive staging cleanup and promotion can escape the intended tree through a reparse-point ancestor.

proposed_comments.title: Make install and uninstall failures transactional
proposed_comments.body:
### Make install and uninstall failures transactional

**Severity:** `medium`

Install and uninstall coordinate filesystem changes with host lifecycle operations. Non-cancellation exceptions must be converted to the operation-specific localized failure result, and a promoted installation must be rolled back on every post-promotion failure. When uninstall fails after stopping an extension, restore the provider if its directory remains; do not leave the install marker behind as a permanent retry blocker.

Preserve cancellation as cancellation, log non-cancellation failures, and ensure marker cleanup and rollback determine the returned state rather than reporting an operation as successful while discovery remains suppressed.

confidence.rationale: Host lifecycle exceptions and cancellation can otherwise leave a promoted extension stopped or permanently suppressed.

proposed_comments.title: Complete process diagnostics and gallery state handling
proposed_comments.body:
### Complete process diagnostics and gallery state handling

**Severity:** `medium`

The npm process result is evaluated after exit while asynchronous stderr events can still be buffered, producing empty or truncated diagnostics. Drain redirected stdout and stderr to completion before using the exit code. Also bind the legacy gallery install control's visibility to the same state that authorizes installation, so an action that must be hidden is collapsed rather than displayed disabled.

Add focused coverage for the failure path and retain the existing gallery state tests.

confidence.rationale: The process error path needs complete stream draining, and the UI must not expose a disabled install action in a hidden-action state.

proposed_comments.title: Guard stale-marker recovery before mutation
proposed_comments.body:
### Guard stale-marker recovery before mutation

**Severity:** `medium`

Startup recovery deletes marker files under extension directories. Checking only the root and immediate child does not protect against a reparse-point ancestor, so the recovery operation can delete a marker outside the intended extensions tree.

Apply the same complete-ancestor validation used by installer operations before each marker delete, and leave the directory in the recoverable-failure set when validation or deletion fails.

confidence.rationale: Startup marker recovery mutates the filesystem and needs the same ancestor safety guarantees as normal installer cleanup.
